keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. By 1356 he permanently controlled Qingyuan, Taizhou, and Wenzhou in Zhejiang. A 1393 census recorded about 2.5 million people across these prefectures; de facto control over Ningbo and Shaoxing. The Red Turban page widens this to most of the Zhejiang coast from Ningbo to northern Fujian; the Fujian stretch is not mapped for want of a named place. No infobox or area figure on either page.

By 1356 he permanently controlled Qingyuan, Taizhou, and Wenzhou in Zhejiang, with de facto control of Ningbo and Shaoxing; the page gives no year of the conquest, only this upper bound (confidence 1). After 1356 the Yuan named him Duke of Qu: a nominal Yuan vassal.

wars.name: Fang Guozhen's piracy against Yuan grain shipping
wars.outcome: No territorial result: Fang seized grain bound for Dadu (still doing so about 1349, which led Toqto'a to repair the Grand Canal), and in 1356 submitted to the Yuan and received titles.
wars.note: The Red Turban page puts the disruption of grain shipments in 1340-1344, before Fang's flight; the Fang page has c. 1349.

notes: Written for ea-06-x from the Fang Guozhen page, the Red Turban Rebellions page and the Hongwu Emperor page. Cliopatria has no row. Start year: Fang's flight to the islands is 1348 but the page gives no land before by 1356 (the 1356 gain is confidence 1 for that reason). The state could be started in 1356 by a gap-filler if the colour agent prefers a state that always has land. Disagreements: the Red Turban page lists the coastal fleet's interference with grain shipments in 1340-1344, the Fang page in 1348-49; the Red Turban page says Fang surrendered to the Yuan court in 1356, the Fang page that the Yuan named him Duke of Qu after 1356: the Yuan dossier (ea-06-a) should carry a vassal relation if it wants one. Not on the pages: Fang's capital (Ningbo is a reading), the northern Fujian stretch of the coast, the date of the Ningbo loss. Jingyuan in the Red Turban summary is read as Qingyuan. Counterparts needing dossiers: yuan-dynasty (ea-06-a), zhu-yuanzhang-s-wu (this batch).
